# Current design and product integration

<!-- Generated by tools/sync_current_design.py from design/current_product.json. -->

PR36 now includes the formally imported partial XT2551-3 donor identity and an actually executed EP3 complete-endpoint/ribbon study on a33e58c. The bounded native run completed STOW/PREDOCK/OPEN with 154/154/161 participants; all three states reject the candidate. Independent STEP readback completed the declared five-file checks and 41-candidate numeric comparisons per pose. Only one donor identity field is known: physical module labels, geometry, all 12 terminal interfaces, fabrication and modified-phone operation remain open. Main remains a1b3cc1; PR35 is separate draft research; PR25 is closed without merging its old driver.

## Product and platform

Equal finished A/B envelopes; one approximately 7-inch flexible main OLED; flat storage in B; B moves upward 79.75 mm and seats normally by 8.20 mm; A has larger-cell priority. The 4700 mAh target uses cell-label sum at a common reference voltage; it is not verified terminal Ah for an unknown pack topology and is not a selected cell pair.

The implementation baseline is `a1b3cc1e0773446f2e36d0a607edf61211dd9919`. The donor reuse design decision and unknown physical identities are in [product interfaces](design/product_interfaces.json); project geometry and reservation assumptions are in [product geometry](design/product_geometry.json).

## Validation and research boundaries

Configured unit manifest: **1324 tests / 35 suites**. Run `uv run --locked python -B tools/verify.py`. Run `python3 tools/sync_current_design.py --check` to check these entry points.

The 109-test selection on bdb1bc1 passed two suites with zero failures/errors/skips and unchanged repository source bytes. Its first EP3 native execution failed in PREDOCK witness construction after retaining a STOW checkpoint: 6 real positive Common pairs and 20 empty-second-cut evaluation errors. a33e58c changes only validated empty-result handling and the NumPy-to-built-in-float witness boundary; candidate configuration and endpoint construction are unchanged. Seven EP3 tests, eight small native API cases and one scalar witness passed on a33e58c. The fresh three-pose native run then completed 15906 pair checks, 0 pair evaluation errors and 0 containment evaluation errors. All three candidate states remain rejected; the six STOW positive Common pairs are independently matched to the first failed execution. PREDOCK retains 35.031250526 mm3 of the finite low-straight witness outside both separate cabin prisms. Independent STEP readback passed the declared 20/20 endpoint and 154/154/161 assembly counts, valid positive solids and 41 recorded candidate bounds/volume comparisons per pose; external 113/113/120 objects have no per-object generator metric baseline in this report. The previous phase3 manifest configured 1310 tests / 34 suites; the 109 tests were not all rerun on a33e58c. New EP4 and physical-evidence regressions retain their own pending execution scope. The earlier 3e6864c donor selection failed with 13 mock-interface errors and f4db100 passed the same 102 tests after a fixture-only repair. Prior 1c970e3 full 1297-test failure, 4fe96be 14-test repair and their disjoint 32+1-suite selection remain separate historical evidence. The last archived hosted inspection is run 39359899335 on f4db100: 12 new jobs, zero steps and 12 direct payment-or-spending annotations. Final publication-head inspection is recorded in PR36 after pushing. No physical prototype, new-layout powered phone, full internal motion acceptance or new FE/QP solve is claimed.

## Actual build and measurements

Formal collection on 2026-10-20 used the existing Pocket4 ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5061: 17 read-only commands succeeded, transport ID stayed 37, server boot/PID/start identity stayed unchanged, and source/design inputs matched exact f4db100. The imported record retains XT2551-3 only; ten other identity fields remain null, no seven-role physical inventory is supplied, and all 12 physical terminal interfaces remain unbound. ro.boot.hwrev is empty and is not converted into a board revision. Earlier software observations (3430/1140 mAh design values, 4570 mAh sum) and Chinese OEM manual values (4700 typical / 4540 rated mAh) keep their own dates and distinct scope. They do not prove the 4700-mAh layout. Actual board/module labels, dimensions, COF, cells/tabs/swelling, terminal topology, RF/thermal space and modified-phone measurements are still required. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase3-20261020/hardware/DONOR_IMPORT.md.

Study CAD can be generated and unpowered research coupons can be prepared while physical inputs remain incomplete. A study export does not assert whole-phone fit, electrical operation or a completed physical test.

Full implementation commands, generated outputs and measured/rejected results are in [the integration delivery](engineering/product-integration-20261018/README.md). Historical entry points remain available at the recorded baseline commit and in the original experiments.
